description: This file defines a 'SearchBar' UI component using the LightningJS framework, including its template, state management, and input handling logic.

methods.name: template
methods.description: HTML-like template for rendering the search bar UI.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initial state of the component, including theme-based styling and the current input value.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Observes changes to 'value' prop and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: input.char
methods.description: Handles character input; appends character to current value and triggers 'onChange'.

methods.name: input.backspace
methods.description: Handles backspace input; removes last character and triggers 'onChange'.

methods.name: input.clear
methods.description: Clears the input value and triggers 'onChange'.
